<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 182.073 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral exact mass of ~181.0659 Da. The closest formula matching this mass, considering typical organic elements and the observed isotopic pattern, is C₉H₉O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9O4</final_answer>
